gloss: without looking aside; single-mindedly; with total focus

definitions.gloss: without looking aside; single-mindedly; with total focus; without distraction
definitions.explanation: Doing something with complete concentration, without being distracted by anything else. Literally 'without even glancing to the side.' Always used in a positive sense, praising dedication and focus.

examples.japanese: {脇目|わきめ}も{振|ふ}らず{走|はし}った。
{脇目|わきめ}も{振|ふ}らず{勉強|べんきょう}に{打|う}ち{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I devoted myself to studying single-mindedly.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{脇目|わきめ}も{振|ふ}らず{仕事|しごと}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}して、{三年|さんねん}で{部長|ぶちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
examples.english: She focused on her work single-mindedly and was promoted to department head in three years.

notes: {脇目|わきめ} means 'a sideways glance' and {振|ふ}らず is the negative form of {振|ふ}る (to turn). The expression is always used in the fixed negative form — you cannot say {脇目|わきめ}を{振|ふ}る. Functions as an adverb modifying the following verb. Commonly paired with: {走|はし}る (to run), {働|はたら}く (to work), {勉強|べんきょう}する (to study), {進|すす}む (to advance). Conveys admiration for intense dedication.
